verification.limits: Interval mapping cases manually pump encoders; separate paced real-worker case verifies paused Stop drain. Sources are synthetic, not native PipeWire capture; native KDE/devices/GPU remain unverified.

conservative_resume: Video render timestamps older than the most recent resume are not re-stamped or replayed; the encoded previous picture remains until fresh timestamped content arrives. Missing video timestamps are rejected. This is not a native freshness guarantee.
fixture_correction: Initial first-frame fixture passed a null PipeWireFrameCleanupFunction and crashed. Fixed to use the required ref-counted owned QImage cleanup; production was not relaxed to accept null.
